before.note: 162 controlled trials, six geometries, no-grasp and four capacities, one/four duplicate grips, 12/48/192 actual subdivisions, eight 20-Hz ticks. Observes foot restriction at updateSupport, after current forces/interval motion; no extra decisions/RNG. No-grasp controls have the same zero-force island row. Missing experimental foot-budget telemetry is null. Snapshots are witnesses, not reusable save files (nonfinite timestamps become null).

before.note: Eight five-second mirrored frontal pairs. Closed-loop mode executes ordinary chase independently; matched-controls reflects the positive-side command instead, isolating the world from pursuit feedback. This diagnostic does not fix inputs to force matching physical outcomes.

movingAfter.note: Mechanical approach probe; straight 6 yd/s carrier, four roster seeds, both sides, fixed geometry, 6/12/48 steps. No tackle attempt rolls, wraps, evasion or assignments. Contact rate is not an NFL tackle rate.
